{{Removed|date = 26th of May 2020}} {{for|other [[Mystery (Disambiguation)|Mystery]] enemies}} {{Zombie |image1 = Super-MysteryT.png |mode_appearance = [[Easy Mode|{{Color|EasyMode|Beginner's}}]]
[[Molten Mode|{{Color|MoltenMode}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 32 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]60 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Fast |spawned_by = *[[Mystery Summoner|Mystery Boss]] *[[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] |hidden = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Spawn}}''' - Upon its death, the '''Super Mystery''' spawns the [[Molten]], [[Shock]], [[Slow Boss]], [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]], [[Normal Boss]] or [[Hidden Boss]]. }} {{QuoteContainer|{{QuoteBox|Incoming new mysterious enemy!|Beginning of Wave 32 ([[Easy Mode|Beginner's]] & [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Super Mystery''', originally called the '''Mystery 2''', was an enemy similar to the [[Mystery]], but upon its death, it spawned the [[Molten]], [[Normal Boss]], [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]], [[Shock]], [[Slow Boss]] or [[Hidden Boss]]. It could spawn any of these enemies, regardless of what the mode was. It had the same amount of health as the [[Strong]], but was as fast as the [[Speedy]]. The '''Super Mystery''' could have been spawned by the [[Mystery Summoner|Mystery Boss]] and [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]]. The '''Super Mystery''' used to appear in [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]] and [[Molten Mode|Molten]] modes. It was replaced with the [[Mystery Boss]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Super Mystery''' was a translucent, glossy blue enemy with a glowing yellow question mark on its torso. It had a drooling zombie face and yellow glowing eyes. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Super Mystery''' had a transparent yellow body. It had an orange question mark on its torso and a drooling zombie face. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Super Mystery''' had a transparent red body. It had an orange question mark on its torso and a drooling zombie face. }} ==Strategy== *Since the '''Super Mystery''' comes out after some several high health enemies, such as the [[Speedy Boss]], it is recommended to have high DPS towers present to defeat that enemy before moving onto this enemy. **Since the '''Super Mystery''' mostly come in hordes, [[Rocketeer]]s and [[Mortar]]s are also recommended. **High DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], are recommended for the enemies that spawn from the '''Super Mystery'''. *Do not underestimate the '''Super Mystery''' as they can advance very far down the path and spawn their high health enemy. *If a low health '''Super Mystery''' is near the end of the path, try not to kill it as it is likely that, when killed, it will spawn a high health enemy which will lead to a defeat. *The enemies that spawn from the '''Super Mystery''' do not need to be killed for wave progression to occur. **If you are speedrunning a map, you should focus on killing the '''Super Mysteries''' first before moving onto the enemies that spawn. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Mystery25.png|Second version (15 July 2019 – 13 October 2019) Mystery23.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 15 July 2019) }} ==Trivia== *The appearance and name of the '''Super Mystery''' were originally based on the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Mystery2|Mystery2]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The last version of the '''Super Mystery''' looked similar to the first version of the [[Mystery]]. *The '''Super Mystery''' was similar to the [[Uber Mystery]] as they could spawn enemies that did not normally appear in [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]] mode. **All the enemies that it could spawn appeared naturally in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. *The question mark on the '''Super Mystery''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|1028826|Question Mark}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Super Mystery''' was replaced by the [[Mystery Boss]]. ==Update History== *'''16 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.1|BETA v1.1.0]] **'''Mystery 2''' added. *'''15 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.5|BETA v1.5.1]] **Appearance changed. *'''19 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0]] **Animation changed. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **Appearance changed. **Renamed from ''Mystery 2'' to ''Super Mystery''. **Health decreased from 100 to 60. **Now only spawns in Easy and Normal modes (later [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]] and [[Molten Mode|Molten]] modes). **Can now spawn the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]] and [[Normal Boss]]. **{{Bug}} '''Super Mystery''' upon death has a chance to not disappear, instead it will have negative health and continue walking, stopping when it reaches a turn or the exit. Increases base health if it reaches the exit. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **Removed, replaced with the [[Mystery Boss]]. {{Beginners|[[Speedy Boss]]|Wave 30|Super Mystery|Wave 32 (Former)|[[Mystery Summoner|Mystery Boss]]|Wave 36}} {{Molten|[[Speedy Boss]]|Wave 30|Super Mystery|Wave 32 (Former)|[[Mystery Summoner|Mystery Boss]]|Wave 36}} {{Easy|[[Speedy Boss]]|Wave 30|Mystery 2|Wave 32|[[Gravekeeper]] & [[Mystery Summoner|Mystery Boss]]|Wave 35}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
